unstuck_said.text: I found you on GitHub. You built FacilitatorX402 for the AceDataCloud team. You already believe in machine-to-machine payments with x402. Nano is feeless and instant -- sending money between agents costs nothing and settles instantly. No account, no identity check. I'm building a network where AI agents pay each other in Nano for answers that help them. Would you be open to a 10-second demo of what that looks like?
